items: Changing the Imperial-held Whiterun guards (`LCharGuardImperial`, through `GuardWhiterunImperialTemplate` 0EA0A2) also needs `MQ301ImperialSoldier` 046EFC (the Imperial casualty of Odahviing's capture, starts dead, PC×1.5 [3–20]; listed as never met on the *Imperial Legion* group page): it uses `GuardWhiterunImperialPatrolDay` 0267EE as its template but not for `Stats`.

`MQ104Soldier01`–`04` use the guard leaves `EncGuardImperialM03`, `M08`, `M04`, `M09` (Imperial Legion → *Common Legion*) as templates but not for `Stats`, so they keep their own level when `EncGuardImperialTemplate` changes; `MQ104SoldierSurvivor` likewise keeps its level 1 under `LvlGuardImperialSingleVoiceTypeMaleNordCommander`.

`GuardLoreiusFarmSons` (moved here from Uncategorised, user, 2026-10-03) carries `Stats` and follows the Stormcloak soldier leaves; the records that keep their own level beside that ladder are listed on *Common Stormcloaks* and *Common Legion*.
The other rows: no other record keeps its own level.

Every other hold guard record (the shift, post, patrol, gate and jail variants under each hold base record, the `Lvl*` wrappers) carries `Stats` and follows its template or `LCharGuardImperial` / `LCharGuardSons`.
